title: Check PNG structure
responsibility: Validate PNG headers, chunk checksums and ordering and collect compressed image data.

inputs.name: hubPngChunks.bytes
inputs.description: PNG bytes from 45 bytes through 32 MiB inclusive, with positive dimensions totaling at most 32 million pixels.

outputs.name: hubPngChunks
outputs.description: Parsed state with validated header, compressed IDAT byte slices, palette/transparency information and completion flags. At most 10000 chunks are accepted; critical unknown chunks, invalid CRCs, broken ordering and trailing bytes are refused.
